note: python tools/research/phase7_extension/v3_models.py needed  --v3sweep v3sweep/ --extra v3extra/ COMMON... --out needed.json     python tools/research/phase7_extension/v3_models.py analyse --v3sweep v3sweep/ --extra v3extra/ COMMON...         --out research/phase7_extension/results/v3_models.json     COMMON = --dev research/phase6/dev_parts.json --catalogues cat80/ --store store.json --priors priors.npz              --sweep research/phase7/results/sweep_v2_extended.json.gz --physics research/phase7/results/physics_dev_with_joint.json.gz  Development only, out of fold (the Phase VII development folds). Labels come from the v3 sweep (fresh v3 simulations of sampled viable candidates); the models, variants, metrics and the selection rule are those committed in research/phase7_extension/DEVELOPMENT_SELECTION_RULE.md before this script was run. 'needed' lists the first grasps of every variant that have no v3 trials yet (to be simulated with v3_sweep.py --labels-json); 'analyse' refuses to select while any first-grasp outcome is missing.

definitions.N_F: examined candidates until the first feasible one, over the complete catalogue
definitions.N_FR_simulated_gmean: rank, among the SIMULATED candidates only (random sample of at most 30 viable candidates per part plus the first grasps of the compared orders) in the order of the method, of the first one robust under y_std; not an exhaustive-catalogue N_FR
definitions.labels: y_std, y_all3, r_mean, y_ext (r_ext), y_load as in DEVELOPMENT_SELECTION_RULE.md

selection.statement: Joint-multi beat M1 by 25.2 points on y_all3 in development (optimistic: selected on the same parts)
